messages:
Olivia Park: Hi all, Olivia here — joining as a short-term contractor on infra. Quick security questions: 1) Are contractors required to complete the Security Basics training before getting repo access? 2) I don’t have a company laptop (contractor issued), can I use my personal Mac for the first week? 3) How do I check/enforce FileVault?

Hannah (People Ops): welcome, Olivia! :wave: Contractors must complete Security Basics and Data Handling before we grant access to any sensitive repos. We prefer contractors on managed devices; if you must use a personal device, request a loaner or a temporary limited MDM.

Diego IT: @Olivia - for macOS run `fdesetup status`. If it says "FileVault is Off" enable in System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault. For Windows run `manage-bde -status C:` in an elevated PowerShell. Our limited MDM for contractors enforces disk encryption and screen lock only — no corporate mail profiles.

Olivia Park: fdesetup shows "FileVault is Off". I can enable but worried about Jamf on my personal machine. Will it install company certs?

Diego IT: The contractor policy is minimal: we only enforce disk encryption, password policy, and do an MDM check-in. No SSO certs or corporate email unless you opt into a full device. If you'd rather not enroll your personal machine, submit a loaner request and we will exempt you from phishing sims until the loaner arrives.

Maya InfoSec: MFA is required for contractors as well. Please enroll as soon as you get the identity invite. Regarding phishing sims: we include managed devices; personal devices stay exempt unless enrolled. If you will access sensitive data (PII, billing), we may require a managed device regardless.

PhishSimBot: User Olivia Park tentatively scheduled for phishing cohort on 2026-09-21. Reply with "loaner-request" to request exemption until a managed device is assigned or contact people-ops for special-case handling.

Olivia Park: loaner-request. Also will enable FileVault now and finish Security Basics today. Thanks!

Facilities: Loaner request received for Olivia Park. Please fill out the loaner form: https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner-form. We can deliver a contractor loaner with charger and optional privacy screen within 2 business days after approval.

Hannah (People Ops): Marked Olivia as exempt from the upcoming phishing cohort and added to the onboarding tracker. Welcome aboard — ping here if you need access escalations. :tada:
